specification.intent: Explicit geometric connectivity; not an analysis or fabrication model.
specification.joint_policy: Endpoints refer to node IDs. Attachment nodes are dependent points on named members. Crossings connect only when declared; ground supports and two E-OB end overhangs are explicit exceptions.
migration_notes: Removed obsolete east upper brace already replaced by mirrored web.
Roof braces terminate on current slope/cap chords.
Short transverse web and hanger ends extend to chord axes.
Timber joists follow their supporting crossbeams; original unsupported tail positions are retired.
Owner correction: S2, S3 and N2 directly below east truss on east_x; top nodes reference E.bottom. S1 and N1 stay at their other support stations.
Owner revision: remove both S2-S3 ground cross-braces; retain the support columns.
Owner revision: north upper chord T-N top / segment 1 has a 4 × 4-inch envelope. Joint axis retained.
North elevation revision: T-N diagonal 8 joins upper east jamb corner to E.north.bottom at N2; T-N diagonal 9 removed.

North upper frame divided equally by a 4-inch midpoint vertical; N1 stops at lower chord. Existing header and above-header webs span the whole western half at retained Z207; western opening diagonal removed.
Owner revision: full X-bracing in the eastern north upper bay. Diagonal 9 reinstated from center-bottom to north-east upper corner, matching diagonal 8 envelope. Crossing is not a declared joint.

south_entry_alignment.note: West face of 4-inch S1 aligns with east edge of existing south entry; attached BR-S braces follow the post.
